title: Native fixed-scalar tensor comparison on representatives
statement: For a symmetric monoidal closed Grothendieck abelian coefficient category B with functorial flat resolutions, suppose pro-etale inverse image along p:X→Y preserves flat objects. Let S,T be specified classes of K-flat fixed-coefficient complexes, P,Q in S whose pullbacks lie in T, and f the exact pullback factor isomorphism, with components equal to the left-derived counit. Then the published leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison satisfies the representative equation: F(r_Y(P,Q));phi_F(QP,QQ);T_X(f_P,f_Q) = f_total;Q(delta(P,Q));r_X(AP,AQ). The representatives are the inverse localization tensorators [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-resolution], and delta is the typed total comparison [def-sf-finite-scalar-complex-tensor-pullback]. For finite scalar coefficients, the constructed exact pullback factors [lem-sf-finite-scalar-pullback-representative-factors] satisfy the required counit equation.

source.place: Tags 00YV, 07A4 and 07A6; Native fixed-scalar tensor comparison on representatives

proof.text: Express the complex localization tensorator through the homotopy localization tensorator. The quotient comparison has identity components. Apply leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp_tensorHom and quotient naturality to get its complex version.

Identify the fixed pullback exact factors with the left-derived counit using leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_app_fac. On K-flat pairs the fixed representatives are inverses of the localization tensorators. Cancel the target tensorator and then cancel the source tensorator under F. Use the proved component equation of the typed complex comparison before specializing the coefficient category.

theorem finiteScalarTensorPullback_normalizationForCoefficients
    (B : Type*) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B]
    [MonoidalCategory B] [MonoidalPreadditive B] [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B] [ProEtale.UpperStarPreservesFlat B]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (S : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) B) ℤ))
    (hS : ∀ Z, S Z → (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat Z)
    (T : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) B) ℤ))
    (hT : ∀ Z, T Z → (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat Z)
    (f : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ (ProEtale.upperStar B p).leftDerivedFunctor ≅
      (ProEtale.upperStar B p).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (hf : ∀ Z, f.hom.app Z = (ProEtale.upperStar B p).leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj Z))
    (P Q : CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) B) ℤ) (hp : S P) (hq : S Q)
    (hp' : T (((ProEtale.upperStar B p).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (hq' : T (((ProEtale.upperStar B p).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) :
    (ProEtale.upperStar B p).leftDerivedFunctor.map
        ((finiteScalarRepresentativeTensorIso B Y S hS).hom.app
          (⟨P, hp⟩, ⟨Q, hq⟩)) ≫
      ((ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison B p).app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
      (uncurry.obj (ProEtale.derivedTensor B X)).map
        (Prod.mkHom (f.hom.app P) (f.hom.app Q)) =
    f.hom.app ((finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalTensor (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) B)).obj (P, Q)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((finiteScalarFixedComplexTensorPullbackForCoefficients B p).app (P, Q)) ≫
      (finiteScalarRepresentativeTensorIso B X T hT).hom.app
        (⟨((ProEtale.upperStar B p).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P, hp'⟩,
         ⟨((ProEtale.upperStar B p).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q, hq'⟩)
